What we offer

Pest control services

Whatever is infesting your space — roaches, fire ants, mosquitoes or termites — we control the population at its source.

Termites & Inspections

Termite inspections, extermination and prevention. We find the colony and the damage early — and treat it with professional products built for the job.

Ants & Fire Ants

From kitchen trails to fire ant mounds in the yard, we exterminate ant colonies — not just the ants you can see — and keep them from rebuilding.

Roach Control

Roaches thrive in warm, damp hiding spots. Our treatments reach the harbourage so infestations are eliminated and kept from coming back.

Spider Control

Spider extermination for webs in eaves, garages, crawl spaces and corners — plus the insect food supply that attracts them in the first place.

Mosquitoes & Yard Sprays

Yard sprays that knock down mosquitoes where they rest and breed, so your family can actually enjoy the yard again this summer.

Rodents & Moisture Control

Mice and rodent removal, paired with moisture control techniques that make crawl spaces and foundations far less inviting to pests.

About us

Feared by bugs since 2001

United Pest Management has served Fuquay-Varina and the surrounding area since 2001. We control pest populations through yard sprays and moisture control techniques that are safe for pets and humans, but tough on pests — for both residential and commercial clients. We also offer termite inspections, so small problems get caught before they turn into expensive ones.

We work with professional-grade products including Termidor, Topchoice, Dominion and Bayer.
